_doc: The one home of this repository's live account values (fleet v2 DEC 7, 2026-11-23). Code reads them here: scripts/site_config.py (Python). The github.io page cannot fetch this file (its CSP connect-src allows only this repository's branch folder on raw.githubusercontent.com), so index.html carries owner, repo and branch on the go.js tag and in the CSP; tests/check_go_page.js fails when they differ from this file. History and docs keep their text as written. The RADE engine repository is not here: scripts/rade.lock.json "repo" names it (the attested release subject).
